newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Synthetic to form ABS resin unit in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Japan Synthetic to form ABS resin unit in Shanghai.

text.p: Japan Synthetic Rubber Co Ltd set up a subsidiary in Shanghai to sell and offer technical support of Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) resin, the company said on Wednesday.

The new subsidiary, Shanghai JSR Plastics Trading Co Ltd, is capitalised at $200,000 and is expected to market products which will be made at its resin compound-manufacturing unit, also in Shanghai, Japan Synthetic said in a statement.
The manufacturing unit, owned 30 percent by Japan Synthetic and another 30 percent by a subsidiary, will start operation in October, Japan Synthetic said.
Currently, Japan Synthetic exports ABS resin from Japan, the company said.
ABS resin is used in parts and components for various industrial products, including cars, air conditioners, computers and refrigerators.
